name: Ringo Granny Smith
original_name: 鈴后 グラニースミス
source:
A lively half-Japanese girl who excels at ballet.
Her friendly smile provides natural comfort.
Maybe her flexible body allows for more acrobatic acts?

"Yoo-hoo! The name's Ringo!"

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/estof_0001/]DMM[/url]]
